scenes.title: The Spices & The Coarse Crush
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate that coarse cracking fractures spice cell walls to release volatile aromatic oils without bitter powder dust.
scenes.visual: Botanical cards (Cardamom, Ginger, Clove, Cinnamon) animate and fracture under mortar impact, bursting glowing volatile oil droplets.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, botanical cards and mortar impact in central stage, takeaway card at bottom

scenes.title: Water First: The Decoction Phase
scenes.purpose: Explain why boiling tea leaves and spices in water first achieves 85% extraction efficiency before adding milk.
scenes.visual: A convective saucepan drawing golden Catmull-Rom diffusion waves into bubbling water at 100°C.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, decoction vessel and spline waves in middle stage, extraction metric at bottom

scenes.title: The Milk & Casein Shield
scenes.purpose: Show how whole milk casein micelles encapsulate harsh tea tannins to neutralize astringency while fat dissolves non-polar aromatics.
scenes.visual: Milk cream swirls into deep tea amber, casein micelles encapsulating sharp tannin molecules into smooth rounded bubbles.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, cream swirl and molecular binding stage, viscosity metric at bottom

scenes.title: The Double Boil & The Perfect Pour
scenes.purpose: Illustrate how rolling boil convection and high aerated pouring create velvety microfoam into steaming clay kulhads.
scenes.visual: Convective double-rise foam boil settling into a steaming terracotta kulhad with upward wisp drifts and golden takeaway seal.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, steaming kulhad stage at top 320px, monumental takeaway seal at bottom
